title: Manage a document collection
description: Using PyMongo and a local MongoDB server, write manage(collection) that inserts the supplied students, updates Ari’s score to 81, removes records with scores below 50, and returns names with scores >= 80 sorted alphabetically. Use the supplied practice-only collection. Download the lab for fixtures, runnable checks and a reference solution. This requires MongoDB on your computer.
hints: Use $set to change only the score field.
Query operators such as $gte belong inside the field value.
rubric: Connect to a local practice MongoDB database.
Pass the downloaded checks against a fresh collection.
